title_en: Famous Chinese People (3/20): Yao Ming, China's Basketball Giant
note_en: 分别 (fēnbié) matches items one by one, like English "respectively": 身高分别达到两米零八和一米八八 "standing 2.08 and 1.88 meters tall respectively." Unlike "respectively," which comes at the end, 分别 goes before the verb, and it is far more common in Chinese: 对手分别是亚特兰大老鹰队和多伦多猛龙队 simply means one opponent was Atlanta and the other Toronto.
